name: Money Changers
overview: The Scriptures reveal the money changers as individuals who conducted financial transactions within the temple, exchanging currency and selling animals for sacrifices. Jesus’ forceful cleansing of the temple, overturning their tables and driving them out, demonstrates His zeal for preserving the holiness of God's house and condemning the commercial exploitation occurring there (John 2:14-15; Matthew 21:12; Mark 11:15). Additionally, the prohibition against usury in Deuteronomy 23:19 highlights God’s concern for just and righteous financial dealings among His people, contrasting with the corrupt practices symbolized by the money changers.
